description: Direct-to-storage LMS asset upload, step 1 of 3 (prepare → upload → finalize). Idempotently reserves the asset under the idempotency key and mints a short-lived tenant-scoped upload grant (single signed PUT, or TUS resumable with x-signature). Not bound by the buffered API-route cap; capability discovery reports domain and effective provider ceilings separately (VIDEO currently 256 MiB). Replaying the key recovers the same reservation and reports READY when the upload already committed. The grant is a transit secret: use it to upload, never log or persist it.

idempotencyKey.description: Durable-receipt idempotency key: 8-128 characters of letters, digits, dot, underscore, dash, or colon. Same key + same payload replays the stored receipt; same key + changed payload is a 409.

name: opentrain_lms_prepare_asset_upload
